confirmedFindings.title: Concurrent REGISTER Read-Modify-Write Drops Contact Bindings
confirmedFindings.body: Reading the contacts array, awaiting an asynchronous DB save, and then setting `[...contacts, newContact]` creates a race condition where simultaneous REGISTER requests from different devices for the same user account overwrite each other, dropping SIP endpoint bindings.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use a Set data structure with synchronized mutations or atomic append operations.
